content: X and Y axis distribution points shall be calculated based on Offset and Shift values. X_array[index] = OffsetX + index * 2ShiftX Y_array[index] = OffsetY + index * 2ShiftY If Offset = 10, Shift = 2 and N = 5 then, axis = {10, 14, 18, 22, 26} (applicable to X and Y axis)
